rv.q: New Village Arts' We Will Rock You offers a nostalgic, if at times baffling, visit to the future.
Under the musical direction of Erin Vanderhyde-Gross , the young cast, mostly NVA debuts with some professional debuts, showed strong vocals and good chemistry.
New Village's production of "We Will Rock You" is best for theatergoers who are coming for the music, not its silly story.

cn.t: Critics find this Queen jukebox musical delivers electrifying rock hits but struggles with a weak, dystopian script that even die-hard fans find hard to overlook—come for the music, tolerate the story.
